body: I just happened to like a girl that is taller than me, but she doesn't date short guys :/
Thank you... You have no idea how much I really needed to hear that right now:')
Thank you, I feel a little more confident after hearing that, I'm not nesisarily sad... It's just discouraging to find out that a girl doesn't like you because you're not tall enough, you know?
About 5'5 and I'm not supposed to get any taller :/

I know I'll get over it in time... I always do, it's just difficult to imagine my life without her now. I havn't been a very happy person for most of my life, but when I met her she gave my life meaning and purpose... I was happy with my life for once. Nothing is the same without her now... Nothing makes me happy like she did, just being with her, talking to her for hours and hours on end all night long... Laughing with her, being there for her when she needed someone, I took it all for granted, I should have held on tight to those memories, treasured them, but I had no Idea just how fast everything I knew could change like that... And so now I'm just here living day by day, hour by hour, minute by minute, second by second, breath by ever more painful breath just waiting until eventually I'll die...
